mapper.insert: INSERT IGNORE INTO account_withdrawal_mark (identity_kind, identity_hash, account_id, withdrawn_at, expires_at) VALUES (#{identityKind}, #{identityHash}, #{accountId}, #{withdrawnAt}, #{expiresAt})
mapper.select:
SELECT id, identity_kind, identity_hash, account_id, withdrawn_at, expires_at, inherited_by_account_id, inherited_at FROM account_withdrawal_mark WHERE expires_at > #{now} AND inherited_at IS NULL AND account_id <> #{successorId} AND
(identity_kind = #{key.kind} AND identity_hash = #{key.hash})
ORDER BY withdrawn_at DESC, id DESC FOR UPDATE
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM account_withdrawal_mark WHERE expires_at <= #{now} ORDER BY expires_at LIMIT #{limit}
